1642.body: Two games can cost the same, promise the same top prize, and still be totally different animals. "$500,000 CASH BLITZ" is a steady-drip machine — most of its money goes out in everyday wins — most of its unclaimed prize money sits in wins under $5,000, with the rest stacked up top. Neither style is "better." They're just built for different players. All of it comes straight from official Florida lottery numbers, current through September 11.
